reason: Most of my business is repeat buyers who just call or WhatsApp me, and I quote them from memory in two minutes. IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and enquiries, so paying Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for another website and a quote desk doesn't solve a problem I actually feel.
objection: I don't see what this adds over IndiaMART and my own phone. My prices change with the market and depend on who the buyer is, so I doubt a system can draft a quote I'd send without rewriting it. And a small remote studio with one chemical client, will they still be around to support this in a year?
would_change_my_mind: If I could try it free for a month on my real IndiaMART enquiries and it actually got more new buyers to reply or saved me real time, with no big setup fee upfront.
